# Rebound Capital Group

> Rebound Capital Group LLC helps homeowners nationwide who are facing foreclosure, and recovers money owed to former owners and heirs after a property is sold. Services include foreclosure help before the auction (options to keep the home or protect equity, time extensions, mortgage assumptions and cash offers) and recovery after the auction (foreclosure surplus funds, tax deed overages, estate and heir claims, and unclaimed property). There is no upfront cost: the fee comes only from money recovered. Based in Miami Beach, Florida, established 2023, A+ rating with the BBB. Call or text 24/7 at 305-563-4920, in English or Spanish.

Rebound Capital Group is not a law firm and does not provide legal advice. Claims are filed through our network of licensed attorneys in the state where the funds are held.

## Facing foreclosure (before the auction)

- [Foreclosure Help](https://reboundcapitalgroup.com/services/foreclosure-solutions): Options for homeowners with an upcoming foreclosure sale, including ways to keep the home, protect equity, or sell before the auction.
- [Time Extensions](https://reboundcapitalgroup.com/services/time-extensions): An attorney from our network may be able to postpone the sale, or get more time before the homeowner has to move out.
- [Mortgage Assumptions](https://reboundcapitalgroup.com/services/mortgage-assumptions): Having a buyer take over the existing mortgage so the homeowner avoids the foreclosure sale.
- [Cash Offer](https://reboundcapitalgroup.com/services/cash-offer): Selling the property before the auction so the homeowner walks away with their equity.

## After the auction (money left over)

- [Foreclosure Surplus Funds](https://reboundcapitalgroup.com/services/foreclosure-surplus): When a foreclosure sale brings in more than what was owed, the extra (also called excess proceeds or overages) belongs to the former owner. It is usually held by the county clerk or court until claimed.
- [Tax Deed Overages](https://reboundcapitalgroup.com/services/tax-deed-surplus): When a tax deed or tax sale brings in more than the taxes owed, the extra belongs to the former owner.
- [Estate and Heir Recovery](https://reboundcapitalgroup.com/services/estate-recovery): Heirs can usually still claim money owed to a family member who passed away.
- [Probate Help for Heirs](https://reboundcapitalgroup.com/services/probate-assistance): When a court requires probate to release funds, we coordinate it with the claim.

## Unclaimed funds and other assets

- [Unclaimed Property](https://reboundcapitalgroup.com/services/unclaimed-property): Dormant bank accounts, uncashed checks, deposits and refunds held by a state.
- [State Unclaimed Funds](https://reboundcapitalgroup.com/services/state-unclaimed-funds): Searching state records nationwide and filing the claim.
- [Unclaimed Funds Map](https://reboundcapitalgroup.com/map): Where each state holds unclaimed money and how to start a claim.
- [Business Asset Recovery](https://reboundcapitalgroup.com/services/business-asset-recovery): Funds held under dissolved companies and closed corporations.
- [Trust Recovery](https://reboundcapitalgroup.com/services/trust-recovery): Funds held under inactive trusts.

## How it works

- [How It Works](https://reboundcapitalgroup.com/resources/how-it-works): 1. Free check of court and county records. 2. We handle the claim, filed through our network of licensed attorneys. 3. Funds are released to the client; our fee comes only from what we recover.
- [FAQs](https://reboundcapitalgroup.com/resources/faqs)
- [States We Serve](https://reboundcapitalgroup.com/states): Nationwide, with a page for each state.

## County guides

How surplus funds work in specific counties: who holds the money, how sales work, and how to claim. Each guide lists its official sources.

- [Miami-Dade County, Florida](https://reboundcapitalgroup.com/states/florida/miami-dade): Florida’s busiest foreclosure court, including condo and HOA cases. Holder: Miami-Dade Clerk of the Court and Comptroller.
- [Broward County, Florida](https://reboundcapitalgroup.com/states/florida/broward): Heavy HOA and condo foreclosure activity across the county. Holder: Broward County Clerk of Courts.
- [Palm Beach County, Florida](https://reboundcapitalgroup.com/states/florida/palm-beach): Higher home values mean larger surplus when a sale goes over the debt. Holder: Palm Beach County Clerk & Comptroller.
- [Hillsborough County, Florida](https://reboundcapitalgroup.com/states/florida/hillsborough): Tampa Bay’s largest county, with sales held online every weekday. Holder: Hillsborough County Clerk of Court & Comptroller.
- [Orange County, Florida](https://reboundcapitalgroup.com/states/florida/orange): Orlando and Central Florida, including many timeshare and HOA cases. Holder: Orange County Clerk of Courts.
- [Duval County, Florida](https://reboundcapitalgroup.com/states/florida/duval): Jacksonville’s consolidated city-county government and courts. Holder: Duval County Clerk of Courts.
- [Pinellas County, Florida](https://reboundcapitalgroup.com/states/florida/pinellas): Dense, older housing on the Gulf coast with many long-time owners. Holder: Pinellas County Clerk of the Circuit Court and Comptroller.
- [Cuyahoga County, Ohio](https://reboundcapitalgroup.com/states/ohio/cuyahoga): Cleveland and its suburbs, Ohio’s largest foreclosure docket. Holder: Cuyahoga County Clerk of Courts.
- [Franklin County, Ohio](https://reboundcapitalgroup.com/states/ohio/franklin): Columbus and central Ohio, with sheriff’s sales online on Fridays. Holder: Franklin County Clerk of Courts.
- [Hamilton County, Ohio](https://reboundcapitalgroup.com/states/ohio/hamilton): Cincinnati, where sheriff’s sales moved fully online in 2024. Holder: Hamilton County Clerk of Courts.
- [Denver County, Colorado](https://reboundcapitalgroup.com/states/colorado/denver): City and County of Denver, sales run by the Denver Public Trustee. Holder: Denver Public Trustee, then the State Treasurer.
- [Arapahoe County, Colorado](https://reboundcapitalgroup.com/states/colorado/arapahoe): Aurora and the southern Denver suburbs. Holder: Arapahoe County Public Trustee, then the State Treasurer.
- [El Paso County, Colorado](https://reboundcapitalgroup.com/states/colorado/el-paso): Colorado Springs, with online sales on Wednesdays. Holder: El Paso County Public Trustee, then the State Treasurer.
- [Maricopa County, Arizona](https://reboundcapitalgroup.com/states/arizona/maricopa): Phoenix metro, where excess is deposited with the County Treasurer. Holder: Maricopa County Treasurer, released by Superior Court order.
- [Pima County, Arizona](https://reboundcapitalgroup.com/states/arizona/pima): Tucson and southern Arizona. Holder: Pima County Treasurer, released by Superior Court order.
- [Cook County, Illinois](https://reboundcapitalgroup.com/states/illinois/cook): Chicago and its suburbs, handled in the Chancery Division. Holder: Held for the court, paid on a petition for turnover.
- [Prince George’s County, Maryland](https://reboundcapitalgroup.com/states/maryland/prince-georges): Maryland’s busiest foreclosure county, next to Washington, D.C. Holder: Prince George’s County Circuit Court, after the auditor’s report.
- [Montgomery County, Maryland](https://reboundcapitalgroup.com/states/maryland/montgomery): High home values in the D.C. suburbs, so surplus can be large. Holder: Montgomery County Circuit Court, after the auditor’s report.
- [Philadelphia County, Pennsylvania](https://reboundcapitalgroup.com/states/pennsylvania/philadelphia): Sheriff’s sales held online, with excess claimed through the Sheriff’s Office. Holder: Philadelphia Sheriff’s Office.
- [Montgomery County, Pennsylvania](https://reboundcapitalgroup.com/states/pennsylvania/montgomery): Philadelphia’s northwest suburbs, with sheriff’s sales online. Holder: Montgomery County Sheriff, per the schedule of distribution.
- [Davidson County, Tennessee](https://reboundcapitalgroup.com/states/tennessee/davidson): Nashville, where tax sale excess is held by the Chancery Court. Holder: Clerk & Master of the Chancery Court (tax sales).
- [Los Angeles County, California](https://reboundcapitalgroup.com/states/california/los-angeles): The nation’s largest county, with tax-sale excess claimed through the Treasurer and Tax Collector. Holder: The trustee (mortgage) or the Treasurer and Tax Collector (tax).
- [Harris County, Texas](https://reboundcapitalgroup.com/states/texas/harris): Houston, with monthly sales and tax excess held by the District Clerk. Holder: Harris County District Clerk (tax sales).
- [Clark County, Nevada](https://reboundcapitalgroup.com/states/nevada/clark): Las Vegas, with HOA and tax sales that often leave excess. Holder: The trustee (mortgage, HOA) or the Clark County Treasurer (tax).
- [Wayne County, Michigan](https://reboundcapitalgroup.com/states/michigan/wayne): Detroit, where tax foreclosure remaining proceeds require an early form. Holder: Wayne County Treasurer (tax), then the Circuit Court.
